name: murad-ios-studio
description: Agentic pipeline that takes an iOS app from a one-line idea to the App Store: research, PRD, design, architecture, code, review/QA, TestFlight, submission.
author: Murad

interface.longDescription: A studio of specialist agents (researcher, PM, designer, icon designer, architect, developer, reviewer, QA, release manager) that drives an iOS app from idea to submission. Two human gates: scope-lock and ship. Verified builds, tests, and screenshots at every step.
